statements.__comment__: Drop legacy AWSAccount->RESOURCE edges to pre-migration shared IpRange nodes.
statements.query: MATCH (:AWSAccount)-[r:RESOURCE]->(n:IpRange) WHERE NOT n:AWSIpRange AND NOT n:Ontology AND n._module_name = 'cartography:aws' DELETE r

statements.__comment__: Drop legacy AWSAccount->RESOURCE edges to pre-migration shared IpRule nodes.
statements.query: MATCH (:AWSAccount)-[r:RESOURCE]->(n:IpRule) WHERE NOT n:AWSIpRule AND NOT n:Ontology AND n.ruleid IS NOT NULL AND n._module_name = 'cartography:aws' DELETE r

statements.__comment__: Drop legacy AWSAccount->RESOURCE edges to pre-migration shared SG-style inbound rule nodes only.
statements.query: MATCH (:AWSAccount)-[r:RESOURCE]->(n:IpPermissionInbound) WHERE NOT n:AWSIpPermissionInbound AND NOT n:Ontology AND n.ruleid IS NOT NULL AND n._module_name = 'cartography:aws' DELETE r

statements.__comment__: Delete legacy IpRange nodes that were never re-created with provider-scoped labels.
statements.query: MATCH (n:IpRange) WHERE NOT n:AWSIpRange AND NOT n:Ontology AND n._module_name = 'cartography:aws' DETACH DELETE n

statements.__comment__: Delete legacy IpRule nodes that were never re-created with provider-scoped labels.
statements.query: MATCH (n:IpRule) WHERE NOT n:AWSIpRule AND NOT n:Ontology AND n.ruleid IS NOT NULL AND n._module_name = 'cartography:aws' DETACH DELETE n

statements.__comment__: Delete legacy SG-style IpPermissionInbound nodes that were never re-created with provider-scoped labels.
statements.query: MATCH (n:IpPermissionInbound) WHERE NOT n:AWSIpPermissionInbound AND NOT n:Ontology AND n.ruleid IS NOT NULL AND n._module_name = 'cartography:aws' DETACH DELETE n
